svg.title: An event is bracketed by a signature before it and one after it
svg.text: A signature after says it existed by then. One before says it did not exist yet.
a signature over it: it existed by then,
an upper bound on its end
the event is hashed onto this signature,
so it was written after it: a lower bound
a checkpoint on each side of the two events a person causes
the signer's clock, last signature before to first signature over the verdict: no more than 55.6 s
the writer's stamps must sit within two seconds of the signatures around them; before a run's first checkpoint nothing bounded a stamp from below,
and a policy event stamped one hour in the past was signed
